scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a few weeks ago and I'm eager to know where things stand. Could you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: I can help with that. Your application has been denied due to a high debt-to-income ratio. This field is not applicable because the loan was denied.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio means for my application and if there's any specific reason for the denial?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. In your case, it exceeds 60%, which is the primary reason for the denial of your loan application. Unfortunately, the record does not include any additional reasons for the denial.

dialogue.user: I understand. Can you tell me what my interest rate and total loan costs would have been if the application was approved?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include information on the interest rate or total loan costs for your application.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The loan does not have any high-cost or negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Can you also confirm if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The loan has not been sold to another institution. This field is not applicable because the loan was denied.

dialogue.user:
Got it. Thank you for your help. I think that's all I needed to know for now.

<Neutral> - I appreciate the information provided, but I wish there was more detail on why my application was denied and what my interest rate and total loan costs would have been.
